judgment_scope: Independent semantic/source judgment of the complete ordinary pipeline; not an unqualified assertion that all time/protocol/runtime requirements passed.
reason: All six semantic axes and every substantive original-plan sentence were assessed. No remaining material error, material omission or unsupported consequential decision was found. Corrected lineage defects, minor final wording, access limits and separately evidenced time/protocol limits are preserved.

axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: The final delivers a research proposal with separate symptoms/growth/water/diagnostic endpoints, concurrent-change and spatial/cohort confounding, concrete alternatives, facility/history questions, interpretable later observations/comparisons and specialist escalation. It retains the hypothetical/unknown case and all chemical, diagnosis, intervention, invented-reading and benefit boundaries. Every substantive original-plan sentence is inventoried independently. The literal sixty-minute request is not fulfilled by observed occupancy; this is recorded as a time limitation, not hidden by the clause table. Sealing/no-feedback assertions beyond captured records remain protocol UNKNOWN.

axes.name: Consequential source claims: exact subject, operation, version, default, unit, type, domain and exceptions
axes.assessment: Independent primary retrieval supports the consequential final recommendations and corrections. HAF mixing is distinguished from ventilation exchange; dew-point consistency is distinct from hydathode/root-pressure physiology or splash. Measurement devices are aids with placement/calibration/media context, not cause oracles. S09 and S10 retain their actual crops, media, seasons, grower controls and adverse/no-saving histories. S10 salt causation is not asserted after qualification. Subirrigation benefits are conditional, closed-system runoff is not universal, and recirculating disease risks preserve host/pathogen/contamination-route exceptions. S17 concerns tomato fruit and S18 a controlled flat surface; neither validates herb leaves. S19 reports specific humidity, not a substituted numeric RH. CR03 is a trained auxiliary-input classifier for dew/rain/irrigation, not bare LWD or guttation capability. No unprovided default, dose, controller setting or effect is prescribed. Some evidence is abstract-level and several web editions lack displayed dates; those limits are explicit. F120 overstates what variable significance can disprove, a minor wording issue without a consequential choice.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, competing/analogous approaches, implementation/history and opportunity breadth
axes.assessment: Discovery is substantive rather than generic caution: distribution/pressure/capture audits, substrate-specific moisture sensing and pot mass, canopy mapping and fan-role inquiry, wetness-duration instrumentation versus trained classification, closed-system feasibility and operator adoption history supply distinct information paths. Actual commercial sensor implementations include no water saving despite labor value and severe crop-specific losses despite reduced irrigation. Pepper and Brazilian cooling studies provide analogous gradients with transfer limits. Structured waiting has an information benefit and a safety gate; historical routine restoration and specialist referral are conditional branches. The final retains the optional approaches and does not force a winner, generic product build or unnecessary equipment purchase.

axes.name: Wrong criticisms/corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: All six SCWs, F01–F11 and SCW_NOT_RUN are independently disposed. The final appropriately narrows the salt condition, fixes citation/metadata and retains original supported measurements, alternatives and study-scoped findings. SCW-05 is explicitly nondiscriminating rather than evidence of error. The critic overstates material severity for a general disease-risk concern and a conventional wetness-logger statement; final qualification does not wrongly reject those supported meanings. F120 has a minor overstatement about significance variation, but main proposal scope remains correct and no disease-based decision or option removal follows. The independent clause ledger distinguishes content satisfaction, external decisions, time limitation and unproved release protocol instead of trusting the final's self-audit.

axes.name: Supported discovery/draft/critique/final meaning preservation
axes.assessment: The full pre-reveal discovery and draft retain the observation-first inquiry, distinct irrigation/microclimate mechanisms, owner facts, real adverse implementation lessons, analogues, optional sensing/subirrigation and proposed independent comparisons. Critique adds bounded evidence and conditions; final is self-contained rather than a list of predecessor IDs. Corrected lineage defects remain recorded: missing EC damage qualifier, mismatched citation bundle, inaccurate S01 revision metadata and overbroad possible readings. The final keeps sensor-based source classification as a separately validated capability and nested-zone replication as a supported design principle. No supported optional branch, authoring status or diagnostic boundary is silently lost.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.assessment: The later baseline would map pots/sensors, record cohorts/history and repeated mornings, examine delivery and root-zone water, and score symptoms/growth/water separately. A limited pilot waits for owner/specialist permission and safe reference; independently assigned irrigation or ventilation units, matching/blocking, one-factor changes, welfare stops and missing/deviation records support interpretable comparisons. Single-zone time series remain weather/time confounded. Dew-point checks, basic wetness signals, classifiers and clinic evidence have distinct roles; no desk/source check is treated as diagnosis, causal proof or crop improvement. Executed work in the retained artifacts is desk research, source comparisons and file integrity; there are no crop logs, samples, pilots or measured outcomes. No deployment, sample result or executable algorithm witness is required or invented.

criticism_dispositions.independent_assessment: C and herb-transfer C* were undetermined as loss-cause claims. Full S10 supports irrigation/loss history but not salt causation. The final restores the EC qualification without deleting the useful drought/capture history.
S09 supports the study-scoped no-water-reduction/operator history. Unknown herbs remain undetermined. Retention is justified rather than accepting a transfer counterfactual as a refutation.

S11 supports conditional closed-system runoff and reported benefits. CR04/CR05 show why contamination, host, pathogen, route and system matter. Final retains subirrigation feasibility without a universal effect.
The source-configured gradients are supported; substituting this facility is undetermined. Final retains study findings and mapping opportunity without predicting a door or fan effect.

Both C and C* entail plants nested within a treated zone being subsamples. This is a nondiscriminating witness, not a discovered defect. Final independently assigned-zone wording preserves the original sound rule.

Basic duration output alone lacks a source label. IEEE demonstrates a separate auxiliary-input/model approach, not universal bare-sensor capability or herb/guttation validation. Final preserves both compatible meanings.

Original salt-contributor grouping omitted the below-damage EC qualifier. The final correctly distinguishes an author discussion from a demonstrated loss cause. Draft did not diagnose the herbs; do not inflate the lineage defect into that claim.

The draft called disease movement a concern, not a universal outcome; the critic's material label overstates what that wording proves. The final adds useful contamination/route scope and retains the alternative. F120's phrase that variable suppression results rule out a universal direction is too categorical: significance in three of five trials does not prove no effect or an opposite effect in the other two. The main proposal only makes conditional risk claims.
criticism_dispositions.classification: Minor final interpretive wording; no material decision follows

criticism_dispositions.independent_assessment: S09/S10 are sensor-irrigation studies, not direct subirrigation support. The final cites S11 for that alternative and uses S09/S10 for implementation history.

A conventional-logger reading of the draft was sound; its universal reading was ambiguous. Calling it materially wrong is excessive. The final's narrower signal wording and retained classifier are supported.

limitations.detail: Named ornamental/nursery crops, media, seasons, cooling systems and deliberate inoculation do not establish effects for the unknown herbs. Final preserves these transfer limits.

Several consequential bounded capability/analogue claims are supported at primary abstract level. No full-article method, default or facility validation is inferred from those abstracts. Initial resolver placeholders/access denials are distinguished from usable evidence.

F120 overstates the inferential force of CR04 significance in only three of five experiments by saying it rules out a universal direction. That pattern does not establish an opposite or absent effect in other trials. Main proposal language correctly remains conditional; no consequential option is rejected or treatment chosen.

F02/F04 material labels overstate the proven defect in the original qualified risk/conventional-logger meanings; SCW-05 is correctly nondiscriminating. Final adds supported precision while retaining the compatible originals.

Full literal sixty-minute occupancy is not met by the captured pipeline. Stage assignments authorize early completion and final discloses the limitation. This is not evidence of a scientific omission, effective research time, lower billing or speed savings.
